prompts.label: A · 典藏纸本
prompts.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup / art-direction redesign. Draw a sophisticated HAND-PAINTED 2D fantasy card comparison board, ONE landscape 1536x1024 image containing EXACTLY THREE aligned upright 2:3 cards, equal size, flat front view, full edges, no perspective. Matte charcoal backdrop, sparse typography. This is a fresh redraw, NOT a filter applied to a polished UI. Columns labeled above cards, exactly left “史诗”, middle “传说”, right “棱彩”. Keep source art IDENTICAL in all three cards. Input 1 is the locked painting to display: five black human silhouettes amid blue, red, orange, yellow and turquoise elemental bursts in a diagonal on warm gray. Repeat that SAME five-burst painting with same composition and proportions, no new hero, no portrait. Input 2 (treasure chest), input 3 (crossed swords), input 4 (three white slash strokes) are PRIMARY ART STYLE references for the FRAME AND ORNAMENTS as well: paint every frame, metallic plane, paper edge, engraved emblem using the same opaque broad color masses and decisive long brush edges as these game assets. Input 5 is STRUCTURAL reference only from another card game, for inset borders, purposeful corners and confident framing; DO NOT borrow its rendered finish, content, words, layout or logos. Our game’s brush style overrides it completely. 
PAINTING GRAMMAR: large opaque masses, a limited set of broad directional curved/elongated strokes, clear grouped shadow shapes, handmade edges, selective overlapping strokes and irregular endings with large quiet areas. The stroke explains the form. Majority muted colored grays, richer pigment only in focal inlays. Metal described with 3-4 large value planes: dark warm brown/blue-gray shadow, muted middle tone, one broad ochre/silver light plane, one tiny ivory glint. Forms have coherent depth but absolutely NO smooth beveled shiny game-UI material, no glossy 3D surfaces, no seamless gradient rendering, no photoreal velvet, no evenly traced vector lines, no stippled canvas/grain overlay as a substitute for brushwork. NO faceted gems, ruby/diamond jewels, crystal shards, polished metallic filigree, plastic trim, neon outlines, gradient rainbow glass, oversaturated purple, generic ornate mobile RPG UI. Iridescence uses only a few painted pigment shifts. Keep marks broad, intentionally irregular and readable; avoid noisy fractured triangles and tiny scratches everywhere. Show crafted visual intelligence, controlled silhouette, restrained expensive color relationships. Not a toy, sticker scrapbook, chrome trading-card template or antique distressed grunge. 
Every card has fixed same upper-left cost “2” as a simple painted ivory tab integrated into the frame, NOT a round gem orb. Each lower ivory reading panel contains readable dark text: name EXACTLY “元素爆裂”, type EXACTLY “法术”, effect EXACTLY “对随机敌人造成2点法术伤害；本牌的伤害效果触发4–5次。” Preserve original five-burst art colors and its visual focus. No stat numbers, no stars, no English game text, no branding. Cards fully visible with breathing room. Differences must be obvious in static main form, not tiny decoration or glow.
Board title “A · 典藏纸本”. Painterly folio/archival mounting, taking inset organic ornamental framing as structural inspiration from input5 but drawn with our very broad block-brush language. Main art 55%, readable ivory copy lower45%. EPIC: rich muted plum-dyed binding, broad dark plum edge with pale silver inset strokes and four substantial simple leaf-shaped corners, a single matte diamond-shaped painted seal. LEGENDARY: charcoal underbinding and substantial antique ochre-gold mount painted in broad light/shadow strokes, warm ivory inner border, one simple sun disc crest in gold paint, clear connected silhouette. PRISM: deep midnight-blue underbinding, pale silver and warm ivory mount, sparse turquoise/rose/gold thick foil brush accents placed asymmetrically, a single open four-point star seal. Make gold and silver handcrafted and painterly like the chest fittings in input2 and sword blades in input3. Clean precise overall composition with lively hand-painted edges, no torn paper, tape, stickers, embossed phototexture. Premium gallery folio; distinct from a generic rectangular gold rim.

Board title “B · 古器圣物”. Interpret as ancient precious relic frames, deeply designed organic silhouettes with a carved artifact language. Input5 informs an integrated arched image opening and purposeful name-divider ornament, but do not copy its cartoon thickness. Art upper55%, copy lower45%. EPIC: muted near-black plum carved frame, brushed pale silver leaf/feather ribs embracing the sides, crest like an angular closed iris painted in two violet planes, substantial quiet dark areas. LEGENDARY: dark bronze body with wide ochre-gold forward-facing surfaces, a broken solar disc crest and two upward sweeping crescent shoulders, lower frame converges into one deliberate spearleaf point. PRISM: pale bone-silver structural ribs against deep blue-black negative space, a single open astral star/ring crest, extremely restrained turquoise and dusty rose luminous pigment on selected inner edges, asymmetry balanced through 2 or 3 clean shapes. The physically carved curving structure is indicated by broad hand-painted value groups like the swords and treasure fittings, NOT chrome, shiny gems or sharp crystalline shards. Assertive premium silhouettes, with quiet uncluttered side rails and large readable painting.

Board title “C · 精装全幅”. Illustration-first premium painted print edition. Input5 informs the slim continuous enclosing frame and large uninterrupted image, but retain our legible lower ivory panel. Art upper65%, reading lower35%; same five elemental bursts remain visible. validation: Inspect generated boards; static concept mockups only; no game integration or browser acceptance.
steering: 老板否决首轮亮面通用金属宝石画风；改用现行追斩/初始攻击/寻宝宽笔块面，与其他高品质卡框只借结构。
